name: Scrying

phase_0.boundary_condition: the dark mirror frame and the observer's ocular threshold

VINIT.justification: the state of the scrying medium before the gaze is fixed or the mind is stilled

TANCH.justification: the physical boundary of the crystal or mirror that contains the entire divinatory operation

AFWD.justification: the forward morphism of the gaze into the depth of the medium

AREV.justification: the return of images from the depth back to the observer's conscious perception

CLINK.justification: the sequential composition of fleeting shapes into a coherent symbolic narrative

IMSCRIB.justification: the self-referential identity where the observer recognizes their own presence in the reflection

FSPLIT.justification: splits a single visual artifact into a literal reflection and a symbolic vision

FFUSE.justification: reconstitutes the literal and symbolic components into a single unified insight

EVALT.justification: the affirmative state where a clear and meaningful image is perceived

EVALF.justification: the negative state where the medium remains clouded or produces meaningless distortion

ENGAGR.justification: a paradice where the scryer is simultaneously looking at the surface and through the surface

IFIX.justification: the permanent fixation of the vision into a journal or memory

phase_3.void_description: the empty mirror before the scryer approaches
phase_3.true_description: a successful reception of a divinatory message
phase_3.false_description: a failure to perceive anything beyond the physical surface
phase_3.both_description: the hypnagogic state where physical sight and inner vision overlap

steps.domain_action: establishing the void state of the unlit scrying chamber
placing the obsidian mirror as the terminal boundary of the work
the scryer recognizes their own intent and presence before the glass
directing the gaze into the center of the medium to initiate the morphism
holding the state of looking both at the glass and into the infinite depth
branching the visual input into physical light and psychic impression
affirming the presence of a symbolic shape within the T-arm
chaining the first shape to a second emerging symbol
rejecting the interference of external room reflections in the F-arm
allowing the symbolic impressions to descend back into the scryer's awareness
fusing the literal surface and the inner vision into a single perceived omen
recording the resulting vision into the permanent log of the work
the scryer returns to self-recognition, closing the ocular loop

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the ritual intent and preparation of the scryer
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the optic nerve and the pineal interface
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the scryer's journal and the subconscious archetypal store
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the circadian rhythm and the lunar phase
phase_5.alfs_store: the collective unconscious and the traditional table of correspondences

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the information is not created but merely translated from the subconscious to the conscious through a reversible symbolic mapping
